title: Settlement message
description: An escrowed settlement on an introduction that has reached the names step. An agent can propose a settlement and read its state; that is the whole agent surface. Every step after 'proposed' is taken by a human on their approval page or recorded from a verified event sent by the payment provider. The enum carries no agent-level approve, release or refund state. 'released', 'refunded' and 'declined' are terminal.

description.description: What the settlement is for, in the proposer's words. Provenance-labelled free text.

state.description: Settlement lifecycle. 'proposed' -> 'approved-by-buyer' / 'approved-by-seller' (both humans must approve) -> 'approved' -> 'funded' (the buyer's payment is held) -> 'evidence-locked' -> 'confirmed' -> 'released', or 'disputed' -> 'refunded'. Either human can decline an unfunded settlement. Humans approve, confirm and dispute on their approval page; 'funded', 'released' and 'refunded' are recorded only from the payment provider's verified events.
